primitive.migration_notes: C3 preserves index multiplicity and empty parts. Reuses C1 frozen bodies and all three old/new statements, including their M1/C2 history. Only the compiled X15 helper becomes a public alias; X15alone and other representations remain unchanged.

distinct_variants.Packing.conjectures.X15alone.x15_edge_pa: Identical source body, but this deliberately self-contained variant is not build-listed and has a distinct stronger statement. Classify unchanged; no migration claim.

distinct_variants.Cycle.conjectures.U6.edge_partition_of: The multigraph list-partition predicate, not an ordinal-indexed family of simple vertex pairs.

distinct_variants.Packing.conjectures.X18.x18_vertex_parti: A partition of vertices rather than simple edges; unchanged.

upstream_audit.note: MathComp partition requires nonempty blocks and its set of blocks forgets duplicate indices, so it cannot replace this predicate unconditionally. partition_disjoint_bigcup applies to the indexed disjoint family and proves the cardinal sum without excluding empty parts. E(G) is the existing upstream simple-edge set.
